visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short brown hair, wearing a beige turtleneck sweater and a brown skirt, is seated in a black ergonomic office chair. She is positioned at a desk in a brightly lit professional office environment, looking toward a computer monitor that shows a YouTube interface. She is actively speaking and gesturing with her hands. On the desk, there is a red cup, a telephone, and several small white skincare containers. (2) The scene cuts to a high-inference close-up shot of a person's face lying flat. A professional in white gloves is using a brush to apply a vibrant blue liquid peel across the cheek and forehead area of the patient. The lighting is focused and clinical, highlighting the texture of the gel being spread across the skin. (3) The camera returns to the woman in the beige sweater sitting in the same office. She is laughing and leaning back slightly in her chair, appearing relaxed and happy. She continues her conversation with someone off-camera, occasionally touching her hair or pointing back at the computer screen. The background remains constant with the desk setup and organized clinic atmosphere. (4) The video transitions to a static ending sequence on a gray-white textured background. High-contrast black and blue text elements appear, including the logo for DRX Dermatology Clinic and specific contact details like a Line ID, phone number, and two physical addresses in Sanchong and Zhongshan. Icons for location and social media are clearly visible.
